notes:
First launch now opens with a short welcome screen explaining what Tarang does, instead of dropping straight into an empty list.

Search now tolerates a typo or two, and a station or channel that fails to play offers a one-tap "Similar" suggestion pulled from its language or genre.

The station and channel lists now quietly check for updates far more often - on every launch, on reconnecting after being offline, and right after a playback failure - not just once every 12 hours, and stay silent unless something actually changed.

Radio and TV also buffer less aggressively now, since live streams can't be seeked into anyway - this also cuts stall-recovery time in about half.
